video_title: Cameron Boozer Press Conference | Grizzlies vs. Jazz

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on impacting the game beyond shooting
quotes.excerpt: I always try to impact the game in other ways, especially in games like this where the shot's not falling.
quotes.quote: For me, I always try to impact the game in other ways, but I think tonight was just one of those nights where you get easy looks and it's just not falling. It's just one of those nights. For me, I always try to impact the game in other ways, especially in games like this where the shot's not falling, just rebounding and getting stops, finding other guys, whatever it is. Overall, a great team win tonight, a lot of energy in the crowd, a lot of fun out there.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on his shooting struggles in his debut: It was just one of those nights where you get easy looks and it is just not falling. I always try to impact the game in other ways like rebounding and getting stops.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer discusses his performance and his team's win after his NBA debut.

quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on the team's energy and defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: When you see guys like that who are guarding, playing as hard as he was playing, getting stops, getting steals.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Cameron, I think it was one sequence where Jaylen Brown dives into the stands to save the ball, throws it behind his back, you get it, finish with the dunk in the paint there. Just how does a play like that lift not just the team, but the entire arena, and how much do you guys feel that kind of intensity when it's happening?

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Boozer
text_blocks.text: When you see guys like that who are guarding, playing as hard as he was playing, getting stops, getting steals, and leading to offensive points, it's great for the team because we're all playing together, we're getting stops together, we're sharing the ball, and it's just good vibes. And then the arena, when it erupts like that, it brings even more energy. That run was a lot of fun out there, it was electric. I think that's when we really opened up the game for us. When we're playing like that, I think we can compete with anyone, so it's a lot of fun.

quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on the team's defensive intensity: When we are playing like that, I think we can compete with anyone. It is a lot of fun.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer reacts to a specific hustle play made by Jaylen Brown during the game.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his NBA debut nerves and excitement
quotes.excerpt: There was definitely some nerves, but a lot of just excitement, obviously my first game.
quotes.quote: There was definitely some nerves, but a lot of just excitement, obviously my first game. Excited to get there and compete. We worked really hard to get to this moment as a team, so it was a lot of fun, honestly. The crowd, they showed up tonight, shout out to them. It was a lot of fun for sure.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer reflects on his NBA debut: There was definitely some nerves, but a lot of just excitement. We worked really hard to get to this moment as a team.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer describes his emotions and nerves during his first official NBA game.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on learning from defensive matchups
quotes.excerpt: Those are two great players and being able to match up with both of them in one night.
quotes.quote: Of course I do. Those are two great players and being able to match up with both of them in one night, I think it's a great learning experience for me, on offense and on defense. But the preseason I matched up with a lot of guys who were really great in my position as well, so just continuing to get better on that side of the ball so I can keep affecting winning the best I can.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on his defensive development: Being able to match up with great players is a great learning experience for me. I am just continuing to get better on that side of the ball so I can keep affecting winning.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer reflects on the learning experience of guarding high-level opponents in his debut.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on the lasting memory of his debut
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to remember this forever for sure.
quotes.quote: I'm going to use the feeling of being out there. It's the first one, the crowd really showed up tonight, we were firing on all cylinders, we were guarding and getting stops, getting good shots. It was just a fun game to play. Even with me not having a great shooting night, just when we play like that, it's such fun basketball and everybody eats. Overall, just competing in my first NBA game, I think it was an amazing experience and I'm going to remember this forever for sure.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on his first NBA game: It was an amazing experience and I am going to remember this forever for sure.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer shares his lasting memories and takeaways from his first NBA game experience.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on playing with Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese is a fun player to play with, obviously he can get his own shot off.
quotes.quote: Tyrese is a fun player to play with, obviously he can get his own shot off. We saw that tonight clearly. He just makes the right reads, whether it's he's passing it behind him in the short roll, whatever it is. He's a fun guy to play off of and him having 45 tonight, it was fun to watch, honestly. But his logo three, I seen him make it, so especially in a night like tonight when he's hot, shoot it if you got it.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on playing alongside Tyrese Haliburton: He is a fun guy to play off of. He just makes the right reads and it was fun to watch him tonight.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer discusses the experience of playing alongside Tyrese Haliburton following his 45-point performance.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his development as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: When two guys come to me, just finding the open man.
quotes.quote: When two guys come to me, just finding the open man. Obviously there's times where you want to go and try to finish over both, especially if you're a guy who can, but for me, just making the right reads. Sometimes it's going to be five times, sometimes it's going to be ten times, whatever it is. But I think for me, my feel is something that's really separated me up to this point and I hope it continues to.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on his playmaking approach: My feel is something that has really separated me up to this point and I hope it continues to. I am just making the right reads.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer explains his approach to playmaking and reading double teams on the court.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on the team's identity and playing hard
quotes.excerpt: I think that stretching the third quarter where we had multiple steals and transition layups.
quotes.quote: I think that stretching the third quarter where we had multiple steals and transition layups and things like that, I think that just really defines how we want to play this year. We want to guard, we want to outwork our opponents. We want to do that for all 82 games. Whether it's a win or loss, you always want to be the harder playing team and that's something we're going to hang our hat on this year. When we play like that, it's a lot of fun, and I think that's why we're going to surprise you guys, because of how hard we play and we're going to outwork teams and win the margins.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Boozer on the team's identity: We want to guard, we want to outwork our opponents. We want to do that for all 82 games. We are going to surprise you guys because of how hard we play.

structured.context: Cameron Boozer outlines the team's identity and commitment to playing hard throughout the season.
